segments.source: Taren auzi conversația despre posibilitate într-o seară în care Sen nu venise acasă. „Acasă” era un apartament de sub turn, ales pentru a demonstra modestie și păzit de două coridoare de agenți. Vessa locuia acolo numai uneori. Relația lor nu primise niciodată un nume stabil. Fusese apropiere în criză, apoi familie, apoi dezacord administrat.
segments.translation: Taren heard the conversation about possibility one evening when Sen had not come home. “Home” was an apartment beneath the tower, chosen to demonstrate modesty and guarded by two corridors of agents. Vessa lived there only sometimes. Their relationship had never acquired a stable name. It had been closeness in crisis, then family, then managed disagreement.

segments.source: — Ce ai vrut să fie? întrebă Taren.
segments.translation: “What did you want him to be?” Taren asked.

segments.source: — O persoană care ar putea refuza rolul fără să simtă că ne trădează.
segments.translation: “A person who could refuse the role without feeling he was betraying us.”

segments.source: — Îl poate refuza.
segments.translation: “He can refuse it.”

segments.source: — Cu ce preț?
segments.translation: “At what price?”

segments.source: — Orice alegere are preț.
segments.translation: “Every choice has a price.”

segments.source: — Nu toate alegerile au statui ale tatălui în piață.
segments.translation: “Not every choice has statues of its father in the square.”

segments.source: Taren se așeză. Oboseala îi făcea mișcările rigide. Inima lui începuse să piardă ritmul, iar stimulentele folosite în război lăsaseră cicatrici în mușchi. Vessa îi prescrisese repaus. Custodia îi prescria permanent o nouă urgență.
segments.translation: Taren sat down. Exhaustion stiffened his movements. His heart had begun to lose its rhythm, and the stimulants used in the war had scarred the muscle. Vessa had prescribed rest. The Custodianship continually prescribed another emergency.

segments.source: — Nu am cerut statuia.
segments.translation: “I did not ask for the statue.”

segments.source: — Ai refuzat de trei ori s-o dai jos și ai numit refuzul respect pentru votul public.
segments.translation: “You refused three times to take it down and called your refusal respect for the public vote.”

segments.source: — Dacă o dau jos, devine mai importantă.
segments.translation: “If I take it down, it becomes more important.”

segments.source: — Da. Simbolurile sunt nedrepte așa. Tot trebuie să alegi ce nedreptate întreții.
segments.translation: “Yes. Symbols are unfair that way. You still have to choose which unfairness you sustain.”

segments.source: Taren privi camera lui Sen. Pe perete erau hărți, Codul și colierul lui Raal. Nicio jucărie nu mai rămăsese.
segments.translation: Taren looked at Sen’s room. On the wall were maps, the Code and Raal’s necklace. No toys remained.

segments.source: — Poate l-am pierdut înainte să înțeleg că îl țineam, spuse.
segments.translation: “Perhaps I lost him before I understood that I was holding him,” he said.

segments.source: Vessa își plie velele.
segments.translation: Vessa folded her sails.

segments.source: — Nu este pierdut. Este numai foarte bun la ceea ce lumea îi cere.
segments.translation: “He is not lost. He is simply very good at what the world asks of him.”

segments.source: Aceasta nu îl liniști.
segments.translation: This did not reassure him.

segments.source: În al optulea an al noii ordini, Festivalul Retragerii fu restaurat.
segments.translation: In the eighth year of the new order, the Festival of Retreat was restored.

segments.source: Numele se păstră, dar ritualul se schimbă. Umbrele mecanice traversau Piața Joasă, iar copiii nu mai trebuiau să fugă spre marcaje. Trebuiau să rămână în cerc până identificau traseul, apoi să aleagă dacă adăpostul, avertizarea sau confruntarea era răspunsul corect. Exercițiul era prezentat ca libertate adaptativă.
segments.translation: The name remained, but the ritual changed. Mechanical shadows crossed the Low Square, and children no longer had to run towards the markings. They had to stay in the circle until they identified the trajectory, then decide whether shelter, warning or confrontation was the correct response. The exercise was presented as adaptive freedom.

segments.source: În practică, mulțimea aplauda numai copiii care rămâneau.
segments.translation: In practice, the crowd applauded only the children who stayed.

segments.source: Sava stătea pe aceeași terasă de unde văzuse primul saryx. Lângă ea, Nemi înregistra. Avea douăzeci și doi de ani, vârstă la care mulți nivari începeau să îmbătrânească, dar Corpul Memoriei îi înlocuise articulațiile afectate și îi prelungise auzul cu implanturi.
segments.translation: Sava stood on the same terrace from which she had seen the first saryx. Beside her, Nemi was recording. She was twenty-two, an age at which many nivari began to grow old, but the Memory Corps had replaced her damaged joints and prolonged her hearing with implants.

segments.source: — Arhiva va numi aceasta întoarcere la tradiție? întrebă Sava.
segments.translation: “Will the archive call this a return to tradition?” Sava asked.

segments.source: — Arhiva va păstra ambele versiuni ale ritualului.
segments.translation: “The archive will preserve both versions of the ritual.”

segments.source: — Și pe cea care va fi cântată?
segments.translation: “And the one that will be sung?”

segments.source: — Nu controlăm cântecele.
segments.translation: “We do not control the songs.”

segments.source: — Nimeni nu controlează lucrurile cele mai eficiente.
segments.translation: “No one controls the most effective things.”

segments.source: Pe platformă, un copil mic îngheță sub umbră. Nu alesese să rămână; corpul lui se blocase. Mulțimea aplaudă oricum. Instructorul îi desenă semnul Feței pe piept.
segments.translation: On the platform, a small child froze beneath the shadow. He had not chosen to stay; his body had locked. The crowd applauded anyway. The instructor drew the Face sign on his chest.

segments.source: — Nici măcar nu mai disting curajul de vechiul reflex, spuse Sava.
segments.translation: “They no longer even distinguish courage from the old reflex,” Sava said.

segments.source: — Poate nu au fost niciodată atât de diferite.
segments.translation: “Perhaps they were never so different.”

segments.source: Festivalul restaurat atrase oameni din toată Dunga. Piața fusese lărgită și acoperită cu o membrană transparentă. Deasupra, cerul roșu părea suficient de aproape încât copiii să-l atingă. Tarabele vindeau modele de saryx, lame de jucărie și benzi cu ritmul Primei Fețe. Vechile figurine ale Retragerii, în care strămoșii alergau spre adăpost, se găseau numai la anticari.
segments.translation: The restored festival drew people from across the Belt. The square had been enlarged and covered with a transparent membrane. Above it, the red sky seemed close enough for the children to touch. Stalls sold model saryxes, toy blades and bands playing the First Face rhythm. The old Retreat figurines, in which the ancestors ran for shelter, could be found only in antique shops.

segments.source: Nemi înregistra din terasa Memoriei. Lângă ea, Sava purta o mantie simplă. Renunțase la conducerea zilnică a Camerei, dar rămânea în Consiliu și era chemată ori de câte ori o cotă producea proteste. Îmbătrânise; articulațiile posterioare îi fuseseră înlocuite parțial, iar puful de pe tâmple se albise.
segments.translation: Nemi recorded from the Memory terrace. Beside her, Sava wore a plain cloak. She had relinquished the Chamber’s daily management, but remained on the Council and was summoned whenever a quota caused protests. She had aged; her hind joints had been partly replaced, and the down at her temples had turned white.

segments.source: Sen stătea pe platformă alături de instructori. Cei trei copii ai lui se aflau în zona familiilor, prea mici pentru probă. Mulțimea îi urmărea aproape la fel de mult ca pe participanți. Când Sen ridica mâna, piața tăcea înainte ca difuzoarele să amplifice gestul.
segments.translation: Sen stood on the platform beside the instructors. His three children were in the families’ area, too young for the test. The crowd watched them almost as much as the participants. When Sen raised his hand, the square fell silent before the loudspeakers amplified the gesture.

segments.source: Copilul care îngheță sub umbră se numea Ari. Sava îi văzu corpul blocându-se: ochii largi, membrele strânse, respirația absentă. Nu era hotărâre. Era vechiul reflex de imobilizare pe care terapia lui Taren încercase cândva să-l corecteze. Instructorul îi desenă semnul Feței, iar familia lui plânse de mândrie.
segments.translation: The child who froze beneath the shadow was named Ari. Sava saw his body lock: eyes wide, limbs drawn in, breathing stopped. It was not resolve. It was the old freezing reflex that Taren’s therapy had once tried to correct. The instructor drew the Face sign, and his family wept with pride.

segments.source: După ceremonie, Sava îi găsi în spatele scenei. Ari tremura.
segments.translation: After the ceremony, Sava found them backstage. Ari was trembling.

segments.source: — Vrei să intri în program? îl întrebă.
segments.translation: “Do you want to join the programme?” she asked him.

segments.source: Copilul se uită la părinți.
segments.translation: The child looked at his parents.

segments.source: — Da.
segments.translation: “Yes.”

segments.source: — Tu ce ai simțit sub umbră?
segments.translation: “What did you feel beneath the shadow?”

segments.source: — Am rămas.
segments.translation: “I stayed.”

segments.source: — Ai ales?
segments.translation: “Did you choose?”

segments.source: Mama interveni.
segments.translation: His mother intervened.

segments.source: — A făcut ce trebuie. De ce îl confuzi?
segments.translation: “He did what he was supposed to. Why are you confusing him?”

segments.source: — Pentru că va fi antrenat pornind de la motivul pe care i-l dăm acum.
segments.translation: “Because he will be trained on the basis of the reason we give him now.”

segments.source: Tatăl îl luă pe Ari de umăr.
segments.translation: His father took Ari by the shoulder.

segments.source: — Înainte, copiii ca el erau tratați. Acum sunt văzuți.
segments.translation: “Before, children like him were treated. Now they are seen.”
